text:
Maya Chen: FYI — Meridian Systems execs want final pricing + compliance signoff by EOD. POC blocked on SSO + egress certs. Need exec touchpoint to commit to Dedicated plan if we can meet egress SLA. @Jonah Lee can you join a quick call? :rotating_light:

Jonah Lee: on it. What's the exact SSO ask? They mentioned SAML + IdP-initiated? Also who from legal is needed for data transfer clause?

Samir Patel: I chatted with their infra yesterday. They want SAML 2.0 with IdP-initiated single logout and IP allowlist for egress. Risk: they require traffic to route through their egress appliances (TLS inspection). That could break cert pinning.

Alex Ruiz: If they need TLS inspection, Private deployment (VPC-onprem) is the safe option. Dedicated could work but requires egress peering. We can propose: 1) Dedicated w/ peering + egress ACLs (2) Private quickstart (30-day) w/ support. Which exec commitment do we need?

Priya Nair: Legal queue has 48-72h turnaround for the Data Processing Addendum we normally send. For their egress clause (no TLS intercept) we might need to escalate to CISO for exception. @Maya Chen can you attach the exact clause?

Maya Chen: dropping the clause — > 'Customer requires all outbound traffic to traverse customer-managed inspection appliances. Vendor must support split TLS or provide exception.' Also attaching comp sheet in drive: https://drive.redwood/meridian/comp.xlsx

deploy-bot: Meridian-POC env health: routing= degraded, certs_pending=1, sso_status=not-configured

Samir Patel: Quick tech note — for IdP-initiated SLO we need to enable ACS endpoint `/saml/acs` and ensure RelayState support. Sample SP config: ```xml
<AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://poc.redwood/acs"/>
``` Can have on-call patch in 2-3 hours.

Jonah Lee: I'll escalate to VP Sales + CISO. Scheduling a 30m call 2pm PT. @Maya can you get Meridian calendar invite for 2pm? I'll bring legal and infra.

Maya Chen: sent invite to Meridian (2pm PT), included @Samir, @Priya. Added note: 'Need egress cert docs and final pricing to sign today.'

Alex Ruiz: Pricing quicktake — if they choose Dedicated w/ peering, likely $X/month plus network egress pass-through. If Private, one-time onboarding + support retainer. I'll DM finance for an accelerated quote.

Priya Nair: flagged to Legal lead (Sara Milton). She can do a hot review if we get exec approval to proceed with exception. ETA 4 hours.

Jonah Lee: Thanks team. Goal: have final proposal + legal note on exception ready before 5pm PT. I'll chase execs on Meridian side in parallel.

Maya Chen: noted. I'll update this thread after 2pm call. :white_check_mark:
